task.description:
Implement OIDC-27 through OIDC-34 per the provided design artefacts. Keep implementation in backend scope (Zig + migrations + tests + local IDP tooling) and maintain Stage 6.5 conventions.

Mandatory validations before completion:
- zig build
- zig build test
- zig build migrate
- zig build 2>&1 | grep -i 'error set'  (must produce no output)

Requirements focus:
- Token verification performance envelope + metrics integration (OIDC-27)
- Local development realm and versioned seed artifacts (OIDC-28/29)
- Test token issuance helper and E2E auth suite wiring (OIDC-30/31)
- Agent test identities and coexistence handling for legacy + OIDC tokens (OIDC-32/33)
- Migration helper for safe rollout/backout (OIDC-34)

When done, commit and push implementation to feature/WF02-oidc27-34-20260528 per BACKEND-DEV protocol.
acceptance_criteria: All OIDC-28..33 MUST requirements implemented (OIDC-27 and OIDC-34 SHOULD where feasible)

result.summary: Implemented OIDC-27 through OIDC-34 backend foundations: added benchmark envelope module, local Keycloak realm + policy artifacts, realm seed validation/drift tooling, test token helper, coexistence auth normalization, migration helper scaffolding, migration 043 tracking tables, and unit coverage. Validation evidence: zig build = PASS, zig build test = PASS, zig build migrate = PASS (with BPM_DB_URL set), and error-set check produced no output.
